wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=None | prevtitle=None | nextcode=TW02 | nexttitle=Training | series=Pokémon: Twilight Wings | colorscheme=Galar}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=TW01 | colorscheme=Galar | title_en=Letter | title_ja=手紙 | title_ja_trans=Letter| release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=January 15, 2020 | broadcast_us=January 15, 2020 | en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Studio Colorido | scenario=木下爽 | storyboard=山下清悟 | director=山下清悟 | artn=2 | art1=篠田貴臣 | art2=高野友宏 | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=TW01-TW07 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rYDmL5VH-uk Letter]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P2ROQZfSKW4 Letter]'' on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|278039|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''Letter''' (Japanese: '''手紙''' ''Letter'') is the first episode of [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]]. It was first released on the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel, the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel, and [[Pokémon TV]] on January 15, 2020. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== The initial chapter of the new seven-episode animated series set in the Galar region is now available for you to enjoy. ==Description== John is a young boy who’s been hospital-bound from an early age. Ever since he saw his first Pokémon battle on TV, he’s been a big fan of Champion Leon—and he’s dreamed of watching one of Leon’s matches in a stadium. Could a visit from Chairman Rose pave the way for his dreams to come true? ==Plot== {{gal|Tommy}} rushes into the ward room just in time to join his friend {{gal|John}} and watch [[Galar]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Leon]] {{pkmn|battle}} [[Bea]] on [[television]]. [[Leon's Charizard]] makes quick work of {{p|Machamp}}, defeating it with a {{m|Slash}} attack. Tommy and John cheer for their victorious idol. John collapses into his hospital bed, wishing he could go to [[Wyndon Stadium]] to watch Leon battle in person. Meanwhile, [[Oleana]] reminds her boss, [[Rose]], that they have to leave for their scheduled visit to the local children's hospital. With a [[Flying Taxi]], Rose and Oleana soon arrive at the hospital where the children have already gathered to meet them. A nurse alerts Tommy and John to the visitors. Tommy leaves to join the other children while John stays behind to write Chairman Rose a personal letter requesting a chance to see Leon battle live. John manages to finish his letter just as Chairman Rose prepares to leave after signing several autographs. He rushes out into the corridor where Tommy informs his friend that the Chairman has headed for the roof. With the elevator occupied, John is forced to take the fleets of stairs up to the roof. John falls to his knees, panting heavily from the exhaustive effort, but continues on nonetheless. He finally reaches the rooftop, only to find that the Flying Taxi has already left. Chairman Rose turns back for a moment and spots the despondent young boy with the letter in his hand. John prepares to head back inside, but stops when he sees the Flying Taxi land and Chairman Rose step out to greet him. John is about to faint, but the Taxi's {{p|Corviknight}} rushes in and saves him. The Taximan is surprised to see his usually aggressive Corviknight having taken a liking to John, and Rose notices this as well. John takes the opportunity to pet Corviknight, and the experience instantly reminds him of Leon and Charizard and causes him to joyfully laugh. As Corviknight flies back to the Taxi, the gush of wind carries John's letter off and it lands at Rose’s feet. John explains that he wrote the letter for the Chairman, and requests that he read it. The Chairman smiles, taking the letter aboard the Taxi. Tommy then reaches the rooftop, checking if his friend has handed the letter over yet. John says yes. Chairman Rose admits that John might make a good {{pkmn|Trainer}} one day, with the compliment leaving John speechless. Inside the Taxi, Rose is impressed by John's drawing of Leon and Charizard. Elsewhere, Bea is tangling with a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Rhydon}}, [[Milo]] takes a break from some farm work, [[Allister]] stares up at the full moon. [[Nessa]], meanwhile, is admiring the ocean view from [[Hulbury]]'s outskirts, [[Hop]] plays around with his {{p|Wooloo}}, and Leon is busy contemplating his next challenge. ==Major events== * [[Leon]] battles [[Bea]] and wins. * {{gal|John}} writes a letter to [[Rose]]. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{gal|John}} * {{gal|Tommy}} * [[Leon]] * [[Hop]] * [[Milo]] * [[Nessa]] * [[Bea]] * [[Allister]] * [[Rose]] * [[Oleana]] * {{tc|Cabbie|Taxi Driver}} * TV announcer * Children * Nurses ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Charizard}} ({{OP|Leon|Charizard}}) * {{p|Wooloo}} ([[Hop]]'s) * {{p|Machamp}} ([[Bea]]'s) * {{p|Corviknight}} ([[Flying Taxi]]) * {{p|Eevee}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Espeon}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Pikachu}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Gothitelle}} * {{p|Gardevoir}} * {{p|Bewear}} * {{p|Rhydon}} ==Trivia== [[File:TW01 Ash Ketchum.png|thumb|200px|The potential Ash reference]] * A {{pkmn|Trainer}} who bears a resemblance to [[Ash Ketchum]] can be seen at the entrance to [[Wyndon Stadium]] with a {{p|Pikachu}}. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|SS}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|SS}} |zh_yue={{tt|信|Letter}} |zh_cmn={{tt|信|Letter}} |fr_eu={{tt|La lettre|The Letter}} |de={{tt|Brief|Letter}} |it={{tt|La lettera|The Letter}} |ko={{tt|편지|Letter}} |es_eu={{tt|La carta|The Letter}} }} {{-}} {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=None | prevtitle=None | nextcode=TW02 | nexttitle=Training | series=Pokémon: Twilight Wings | colorscheme=Galar}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Pokémon: Twilight Wings episodes|01]] [[Category:Episodes written by Sou Kinoshita]] [[Category:Episodes storyboarded and directed by Shingo Yamashita]] [[Category:Episodes storyboarded by Shingo Yamashita]] [[Category:Episodes directed by Shingo Yamashita]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time animation directors]] [[Category:Episodes by multiple animation directors]] [[de:Pokémon: Zwielichtschwingen Folge 1: Brief]] [[es:PAC01]] [[fr:AC01]] [[it:TW01]] [[zh:破晓之翼 第1集]]
